python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Values from the table (in millions of dollars)
fy_1947 = 1459.5  # FY 1947 appropriations
fy_1950 = 2106.4  # FY 1950 appropriations

print(f"Number of years: {n}")

print(f"CAGR as percent: {cagr_percent}")
